characters.description: Round chubby face with slightly droopy, sleepy eyes and a small nose; short tousled black hair that sticks up at the crown; warm light-tan skin; small and slightly stocky build; default expression is a dreamy, absent-minded half-smile that shifts to wide-eyed surprise or guilty grin
characters.name: Minh
characters.outfit: Oversized dusty-blue hoodie with a front pocket, soft grey sweatpants, white socks — no logos or text; a pair of wireless earbuds hanging loosely around the neck as a character prop
characters.personality: Easily distracted and impulsive but genuinely sweet; quick to laugh at himself

characters.description: Oval face with bright almond-shaped eyes and arched brows; shoulder-length straight black hair with a neat fringe; warm medium-tan skin; tall and slim build with good posture; default expression is a warm, knowing smile — the kind that says 'I told you so' affectionately
characters.name: Lan
characters.outfit: Mustard-yellow oversized shirt tucked into terracotta wide-leg trousers; simple white sneakers; small round tortoiseshell glasses perched on her nose — no logos or text
characters.personality: Calm, older-sister energy — wise and gently teasing, never preachy

rationale: The script clearly features two distinct characters interacting throughout all three scenes: Minh (the distracted student the audience identifies with) and Lan his older sister (the guide/mentor). Both are needed for the story to function. They are visually differentiated by face shape, hair length, height/build, colour palette (cool blue vs warm mustard/terracotta), and accessories (earbuds vs glasses), making them easy to tell apart as flat cut-out cartoons.
